templates.name: High-Converting Doctor Cold Outreach
templates.subject: Quick question regarding patient no-show reduction at {{organization}}
templates.content:
Hi {{name}},

I noticed your clinic {{organization}} in {{locality}}, {{city}} is seeing tremendous patient volume in {{specialty}}.

Most clinical directors we partner with find that 18% to 26% of scheduled appointments drop off due to manual confirmation gaps.

Our AI Sales & Patient Automation engine recently helped Dr. Mehta eliminate 82% of no-shows and increase booked revenue by $14,000 in under 60 days via intelligent WhatsApp triage.

Would you be open to a brief 7-minute executive walkthrough this Thursday at 3:00 PM?

Best regards,
{{repName}}
Apex Healthcare Solutions

templates.name: Interactive Clinic WhatsApp Pitch
templates.subject: WhatsApp Quick Engagement
templates.content:
Hello {{name}}! 🩺

We’ve automated patient appointments and zero-touch booking for leading {{specialty}} clinics in {{locality}}, {{city}}.

✅ 24/7 WhatsApp AI receptionist for patient queries
✅ Instant reminder sequences with one-tap reschedule
✅ Direct sync into your existing clinic EHR

Would you like a quick 60-second video demo sent directly here?

👉 Reply 'DEMO' to see it live in action.

templates.name: AI Voice SDR Autonomous Script
templates.subject: Doctor Reception Gatekeeper & Follow-up Call
templates.content: Hello! This is Sarah calling on behalf of Apex Healthcare. I'm calling to speak with {{name}} or the Clinic Practice Manager regarding {{organization}}'s patient booking automation in {{city}}. We recently launched an AI solution that connects with Practo and eliminates missed inquiries for top {{specialty}} practices. Could you connect me with Dr. {{name}} or would it be best to send a quick overview directly to their WhatsApp?
